description:
portraits of sinners and their IDs from the game "Limbus Company"

Spoiler

Download

I used Portrait changer for quick in-game NPC portrait change, it works on 0.97, and even though it‘s designed for UAF you can still use all the portraits available on the character creating screen

Recommend Second-in-Command , which allows you to mess around the sector with 12 idiots.

Spoiler

I added some battle announcers because I want them to play the roles of administrators.

Spoiler
Samjo:*bubbling sounds
